definitions.explanation: A sword made by traditional Japanese methods, with a curved, single-edged blade. Today it is valued as a work of art; owning one requires registration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{日本刀|にほんとう}。
⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{日本刀|にほんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw an exhibition of Japanese swords at the museum.
